Here’s a shorter, polished follow-up email you can send Rudy:

:::writing{variant="email" id="48271" subject="Agreement & Next Steps"}
Hi Rudy,  

It was great chatting with you again today. We’re really excited about the opportunity to work with you and Carrie when the timing feels right for you and the practice. We truly feel like this is going to be a great fit.  

I’ve attached the agreement for you to review whenever you have a chance. If you’d like to go ahead and sign it ahead of payment, you’re more than welcome to do that as well. Of course, nothing officially begins and we would never hold you accountable to timelines, deliverables, or onboarding milestones until payment is completed and you’re fully ready to move forward. We just wanted to make the process as easy and seamless as possible on your end.  

Really looking forward to what we can build together and excited to reconnect next week.  

Happy Aloha Friday 🌺  

Bethany
:::
